subject.title: [Bug]: Steer message during active tool call crashes embedded agent (EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError)

question: Does current main's embedded-attempt session-lock controller already eliminate the v2026.7.1 steer-during-tool-call takeover race, or does this issue require an additional repair beyond the work linked from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003?
rationale: The shipped reproduction is credible, but current main has substantial new lock and steering coordination without an identified proving commit or an exact regression test, so source inspection alone cannot safely resolve whether implementation work remains.

options.title: Require current-main regression proof
options.body: Reproduce the tool-call steering sequence on current main or add a focused failing test before deciding whether a new fix is needed.

options.title: Route to existing steering work
options.body: Treat the linked steering implementation as the owner only if its maintainer can show it also prevents external transcript mutation and session takeover.

recommendation.title: Require current-main regression proof
recommendation.body: Reproduce the tool-call steering sequence on current main or add a focused failing test before deciding whether a new fix is needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing candidate for the broad embedded-runner ownership and proof decision, while the more focused contributors can validate the steering implementation details.
